concept.logline: On sunlit, epic Dramesa, you race to recover the echo keys and restore the Eagle Mesa.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Tobin
nodes.text: So you've come to Trailhead Post at last. I am Sheriff Tobin. On sunlit, epic Dramesa, you race to recover the echo keys and restore the Eagle Mesa.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Tobin
nodes.text: Back again. Trailhead Post is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Tobin
nodes.text: Go to Prospector Camp, then Echo Cave. Whatever still remembers Red Canyon Race Against the Sun is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Tobin
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Trailhead Post, Red Canyon Race Against the Sun was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Adventurous, even then.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Tobin
nodes.text: Prospector Camp: Prospector Camp: a camp on the way out from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Tobin
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Red Canyon Race Against the Sun back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Tobin
nodes.text: Echo Cave: Echo Cave: a cave on the way out from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Ranger
nodes.text: Kai the Ranger circles your feet, then looks toward Red Cliff Dwellings as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Ranger
nodes.text: Kai the Ranger keeps close and glances back at Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Ranger
nodes.text: It turns toward Red Cliff Dwellings. Red Cliff Dwellings: a ruin on the way out from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Rock Stalker
nodes.text: The rock stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Trailhead Post. Nadia the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Red Canyon Race Against the Sun that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Echo Cave after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Dust Lizard
nodes.text: The dust lizard freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
